title: Trading Update
text: The Board now expects FY27 adjusted EBITDA of £6m to £7m, below the previous £10m to £12m range. Revenue is 12% lower year on year and net cash has fallen from £8m to £2m. The Company describes operational progress as encouraging.

title: Trading Update
text: FY27 adjusted PBT is now expected to be at least £14m compared with prior guidance of £11m to £12m. Net debt at year end was £9m, below the previously indicated £15m.

title: Major Contract Award
text: The Company has signed a strategically important multi-year contract with a global customer. Contract value, duration, margin and expected revenue contribution are not disclosed. Guidance is unchanged.

title: Placing and Subscription
text: The Company is raising £4.0m gross at 2p per share, a 42% discount to the prior close. 200m new shares will be issued against 150m existing shares. Without the proceeds the Company would have insufficient working capital beyond September. One warrant is issued for every two placing shares.

title: Acquisition
text: The Company will acquire Target Ltd for £45m. Target generated £30m revenue and £6m EBITDA. The purchase is funded with £35m new debt and £10m cash. Pro-forma net debt is expected to be 3.1x EBITDA. Management expects annual cost synergies of £2m by FY29.

title: Director/PDMR Shareholding
text: The Chief Executive purchased 500,000 ordinary shares in the market at 20p per share for cash. Following the purchase, the CEO holds 1,200,000 shares. No trading update is provided.

title: PDMR Dealing
text: Following vesting of an LTIP award, the CFO sold 80,000 of 200,000 vested shares solely to meet tax liabilities and retained the balance. The exercise price was nil.

title: Final Results
text: The auditor reports a material uncertainty related to going concern. The Group breached its leverage covenant after year end and obtained a waiver to 30 November. The facility is fully drawn and management states that additional funding will be required.

title: Directorate Change
text: The Chief Executive has left the Company with immediate effect. The CFO will act as interim CEO. No reason is provided and the Company states that current-year guidance remains unchanged.

title: Final Results
text: Adjusted EBITDA increased 18% to £12m and revenue rose 10% to £80m. Operating cash flow fell to £1m from £9m due to higher receivables, while net debt increased to £22m from £10m. Management calls the year a strong performance.

title: Recommended Cash Offer
text: The boards have agreed a recommended firm cash offer of 125p per share, representing a 48% premium to the undisturbed closing price. Completion remains subject to shareholder and court approval.

title: Scheme Effective
text: The previously announced 90p cash acquisition has become effective. Settlement is expected within 14 days and cancellation of admission to AIM will occur tomorrow.

title: Clinical Trial Update
text: The first patient has been dosed in the Phase II study. No efficacy data, partnership economics, regulatory timetable or funding update is disclosed.

title: Contract Update
text: The Group's largest customer, representing approximately 28% of prior-year revenue, has terminated its contract with immediate effect. The Board is reviewing full-year guidance.

title: Total Voting Rights
text: The total number of voting rights in the Company is 100,000,000. This figure may be used by shareholders for disclosure calculations.

title: Grant of LTIP Awards
text: The Company granted 3,000,000 nil-cost options, including 2,000,000 to the CEO and CFO. Awards vest after three years subject to adjusted EBITDA and operating cash conversion targets. Issued share capital is 60,000,000 shares.
